# FEMIC Full TSA 48 Instance

> Agent-facing index for the full TSA 48 model. Read the linked pages before you change the project.

## Start here

- [Home](index.html): the documentation home for the project.
- [API reference](api/index.html): every public function, with its parameters, types, and return values.

## Guides

- [TSA 48 AOI](aoi.html): the full-TSA boundary, NICC intersection, and K3Z tenure sources.
- [Model build](model-build.html): the FEMIC-to-ws4 chain, calibrated THLB, part accounting, commands, and runtime boundary.
- [Web UI](web-ui.html): the ws4 serve command, exact geometry, land-base underlay, EPSG:3005 handling, and verification checks.
- [Related instance](https://github.com/UBC-FRESH/femic-northisland-instance): the independent NICC + K3Z dataset and its deliberately related scope.

- [VDYP runtime boundary](../notes/reference/vdyp-runtime.md): Wine, the batch timeout evidence, and the provisional auto-sampling workaround.
